It is easily verifiable (the agent must be within a certain distance of the wall torch and look at it), does not require deep Minecraft domain knowledge, and can be set up in a visually interesting scene. milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the wall torch at spawn-relative (-6, 2, 3) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the torch.

scene_description: A small outdoor area with three structures on a grass platform: a stone brick building to the northeast, an oak plank partial wall to the northwest, an oak fence line in the middle, and a cobblestone pillar to the west with a single wall torch on its south face. The player must explore the area and locate the wall torch mounted on the cobblestone pillar.
task_text: Find the wall torch in the scene. Explore the area and look at all structures to locate a wall torch mounted on a wall.
design_notes: The wall torch is placed at ~-6 ~2 ~3 on the south face of a 2-wide, 4-tall cobblestone pillar at ~-6/~-5, z=4. The torch faces south so it is visible when approaching from the south. Other structures (stone brick building, oak plank walls, oak fence, lantern) serve as distractors to make the scene interesting. The scene is compact within ~8 blocks of spawn. The grass platform ensures flat terrain for easy navigation.
